teams.heading: Fijian forward Saimoni Vunilagi dies aged 26 in Japan of suspected heatstroke
teams.body: The rugby community is mourning the tragic death of Fijian back-row forward Saimoni Vunilagi, who has passed away in Japan aged 26. Vunilagi, a towering 196cm loose forward for second-division club Kyushu KV, died in a Fukuoka hospital after displaying symptoms consistent with severe heatstroke following a team practice on Monday. The club released a statement expressing they are "devastated by this sudden news" as local temperatures reached 35 degrees Celsius. Vunilagi had relocated to Japan for university before starting his professional career in 2023.

lead.why: The tragic death of Fijian back-rower Saimoni Vunilagi in Japan has devastated his club and shocked the rugby community.

He further suggested that Borthwick needs to grant coach Lee Blackett more influence on the team's attacking imprint, while also questioning the continued exclusion of centre Max Ojomoh.

teams.heading: Alun Wyn Jones joins Ospreys board to aid club's survival fight
teams.body: Former Wales captain Alun Wyn Jones has been appointed as a director at the Ospreys with immediate effect. The 40-year-old former lock joins the board at a turbulent period for the region, which is currently competing against the Scarlets for one of the three professional licences proposed by the Welsh Rugby Union. Jones stated that he intends to use his experience in business and rugby to help drive long-term stability as the club prepares for its move to St Helen’s.

teams.heading: Kieran Read identifies Argentina’s effective blueprint for unlocking South African defence
teams.body: Former All Black captain Kieran Read believes Argentina provided the perfect tactical template for exploiting South Africa’s rush defence. While Los Pumas narrowly lost their recent encounter, Read noted that their use of width, chip kicks, and cross-field play successfully exposed space behind the Springbok line. He suggested that New Zealand should adopt a similar approach to target the fringes, trusting quick ball and depth to manipulate a South African defensive system that remains reliant on their traditional structure.

teams.heading: Japan rugby community mourns following death of Saimoni Vunilagi
teams.body: The Japanese rugby community is in mourning after the death of Saimoni Vunilagi, who passed away on Friday from suspected heatstroke. The 26-year-old Kyuden Voltex back-rower, who previously played for Suntory Sungoliath, fell ill following a training session in Fukuoka. A minute’s silence was observed before the most recent international match to honour his memory. The Japan Rugby League One office extended its heartfelt condolences to his family as the club asks for privacy during this period of profound grief.

teams.heading: New Zealand defeat South Africa as Will Jordan shines at Ellis Park
teams.body: The All Blacks claimed a 33-16 victory over the world champion Springboks in Saturday’s opening test. Will Jordan scored two tries in a clinical performance, with New Zealand crossing the whitewash five times compared to South Africa's one. Despite facing intense scrum pressure, the visitors dominated key efficiency metrics, averaging 3.67 points per entry into the 22. Coach Dave Rennie noted the scoreline was flattering, admitting it was an absolute arm wrestle before his side pulled away to secure the win.

teams.heading: Springboks suffer opening series defeat as All Blacks dominate at Ellis Park
teams.body: South Africa fell to a 33-16 defeat against New Zealand on Saturday, conceding 5 tries in a disappointing opening to the Greatest Rivalry series. Rassie Erasmus dismissed suggestions that the loss was "catastrophic," pointing to previous series where the Springboks recovered from initial defeats. The world champions struggled with handling errors and accuracy, eventually finishing the match with two men in the sin-bin. Erasmus acknowledged the challenge ahead, noting that South Africa must now win three consecutive matches to claim the series.

lead.why: The result is the most significant news of the day, marking a major opening defeat in the Greatest Rivalry series.
